notes:
• New Gramob logo in the driver and passenger apps, admin, landing site and favicons: the orange tile with the pin G ("D" on the driver app, "P" on the passenger app) beside "GRAMOB" replaces the stacked G mark, wordmark and slogan; on orange grounds the tile shows white with an orange G, and on the dark landing header and footer the name is white; the apps use app-sized copies with a transparent ground (full-size art kept in apps/driver/branding and apps/passenger/branding), the driver online/offline notification shows the new tile, the driver intro no longer shows "Drive Earn Grow" under the logo; admin and landing get new favicons (SVG plus 16-256 px PNG/ICO); the phone home-screen app icon is unchanged; version W1.3.70 / M2.0.201
• Internet calls between passenger and driver: the existing Call buttons (passenger On the way, In progress, Scheduled ride; driver Go to pickup, Active ride, Requests, Scheduled ride detail) now ring the other person's Gramob app over the internet — WebRTC audio, signalled on a new /calls Socket.IO namespace, with STUN/TURN from the API and an FCM push (INCOMING_CALL / CALL_ENDED, 30 s lifetime) for a closed or locked phone; button placement and visibility unchanged, and "Call by phone" (the dialler) is offered when the internet call cannot go through
• Driver and passenger app sign-in: with the keyboard up the mobile field is no longer covered — the Terms & Privacy line, pinned at the bottom, moves to the end of the scrolling page while the keyboard is open and the page scrolls so the card (field and Get OTP / Continue) sits just above the keys; the empty strip above the keyboard is gone (the navigation bar was counted twice); layout only, no change in behaviour
• Passenger app pickup and drop maps: the map takes about a fifth of the screen, at most 180dp (was about a third, up to 280dp on Plan your ride and 300dp on the pin screen), so recent trips and the nearby landmarks show under it without scrolling; sizes only, no change in behaviour
• Passenger app: a navigation button on the trip-in-progress map opens Google Maps with the road from the driver's current position to the drop — the same free Maps link as the family tracking page's button; nothing else on the screen changes
• Passenger app: switching location back on now finds the passenger's position by itself — on returning from the settings page or from the quick-settings panel — instead of leaving a booking screen with neither the notice nor a pin; a pickup already placed by hand stays where it was put
• Passenger referrals join driver referrals as a second, separate programme: a driver's one code brings in drivers and passengers, each counted and rewarded on its own, and fifty of either earns a free month of subscription — reaching both earns both
• A second location shared into the open booking screen now becomes the destination too: the pending share is a stream the screen watches rather than a value it reads once at creation, so the link that arrives while the screen is already up no longer leaves the first place sitting there
